title: OpenTelemetry Collector configuration
versionOrDate: Current Collector configuration documentation reviewed 2026-08-02; component syntax, defaults and stability remain distribution- and version-specific
relevance: Official configuration contract showing that defining a receiver, processor, exporter, connector or extension does not enable it; components must be referenced by the appropriate `service` pipeline or extension list. It supports the lesson's configured-versus-active diagnosis and `otelcol validate` preflight. Example wildcard bind addresses are convenience examples rather than safe production defaults, and every selected component's own README and deployed distribution must be checked.
